name: Real Data Evidence Gate
description: Validate submitted real data, uploaded camera video evidence, and pose repeatability before SysID, agentic tuning, or release scoring trust the evidence.
validators: aligned records must include consistent action and joint dimensions
minimum configured episode count must be present
object pose estimate and reference fields must be populated
pose repeatability must stay under the configured real-robot pose gate
uploaded camera/calibration videos should provide reprojection and suggested camera-parameter evidence when configured
